name: Kikou
source:
A demon dwelling in the demonic sword "Kogetsu", which is handed down in the Amagi family. She has served the Amagi family since long ago and is loyal.

Her current master is Touya's father, Shinichirou. Although she used to only follow her masters, she now tends to follow Touya as a servant as well.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/react-kikou]official website[/url]]
